title: 第二十九章   做笔录
content_zh:
所以，就在陈木和苏林依以及孙依诗见到警察的时候，最淡定的要属陈木，最茫然的要属孙依诗，但是还算是理智并且清楚的知道到底是为什么的就只有苏林依了，看来昨天晚上的事情还是让警方知道了。

    “陈先生，孙小姐，苏小姐，关于昨天晚上在夜行街的地下停车场发生了一起斗殴事件，作为当事人的你们，警方需要你们提供一些证词。”前来请人的正是杨环嘉，身为一个副局长按理来说此时并不应该出现，但是陈木这个人身上似乎是有很多秘密的样子让杨环嘉心中一直都有一个结，于是她想要掌握陈木的第一手资料，那么就要一直跟着陈木，看看他的行为举止。

    “好，我们跟你们走。”苏林依平静的说道，配合警方什么的这种良好公民应该做的事情他自然也会做，陈木这个木头脸基本上是什么都不会说的，而孙依诗现在的样子还是不太适合应付这样的事情，于是这件事就只有苏林依来主持大局了。

    三个人跟着警察上了警车，但是这里的地点好巧不巧的正是学校的大门口，又是早上的上学时间，来来往往的人很多，见到他们的校花和警察一起走了便有许许多多莫名其妙的猜测纷涌而出。

    “你说他们三个这是怎么了？怎么就连警察都出动了？”

    “不知道啊，听说校花是个什么富家千金，是不是家里面有是什么事儿啊。”

    “是吧是吧，那么有钱怎么可能不出什么事儿啊。”

    有时候人的心和人的嘴一样的恶毒，明明只是一件十分正常的事情，不知道为什么到了一些脑残的嘴里就开始越传越离谱了。

    但是这些议论声虽然没有被陈木三人听见，却恰好被路过的王艺听见了，“你们说什么？谁允许你们乱说话的？欠揍了吧？”王艺想要教训陈木这件事情是确有其事的，但是并没有打算把苏林依牵扯进来，于是这时候听见有人说苏林依的坏话自然是不能忍了。

    刚刚还在嚼舌根的忍被王艺这突如其来的话给吓坏了，纷纷作鸟兽散不敢再多说什么对于苏林依不好的话了，而王艺觉得自己的效果已经达到了，这才大摇大摆的去上课了。

    他知道昨天晚上的事情和苏林依没有关系，就算是去了警察局苏林依也不会有什么事情，但是一想到昨天拍过去的人都被陈木给打的住院了，而且陈木还十分叼气的让人转告自己那些话，就更加的生气了。

    “陈木，我一定会让你付出代价，就算是你打了我手下的人又怎么样？杀手组织那么多我就不信你不死。”王艺在心底狠狠的说道，之前还只是想要教训一下陈木，现在心里面想的都市怎么样才能够搞死陈木。

    王艺现在内心十分扭曲，但是表面上却看不出来，依旧是衣服很正常的样子去上课了，而关于苏林依的谣言也慢慢地平息了，毕竟谁也不想去得罪一个有权有势的二世祖吧？

    陈木觉得自己自从穿越过来就很无语，一大堆的麻烦事情找上自己不说，现在还要和这个叫杨环嘉的副局长在这里回答一些很无聊的问题，他发现自己现在越来越不能够理解这个星球上的人都是什么样的思维了。

    “姓名。”

    “陈木。”

    “性别。”
content_en:
Therefore, when Chen Mu, Su Linyi and Sun Yishi met the police, Chen Mu was the calmest and Sun Yishi was the most confused. However, Su Linyi was the only one who was still rational and clearly knew what happened. It seemed that the police knew what happened last night.

    "Mr. Chen, Miss Sun, Miss Su, regarding a fight that took place in the underground parking lot of Yehang Street last night, as the parties involved, the police need you to provide some testimony." The person who came to invite people was Yang Huanjia. As a deputy director, he should not appear at this time, but Chen Mu seemed to have many secrets, which made Yang Huanjia feel knotted in his heart. So if she wanted to get the first-hand information about Chen Mu, she had to follow Chen Mu to see his behavior.

    "Okay, let's go with you." Su Linyi said calmly. He would naturally do what a good citizen should do, such as cooperating with the police. Chen Mu, who has a wooden face, basically can't say anything, and Sun Yishi's current appearance is still not suitable for dealing with such a thing, so only Su Linyi will take charge of the overall situation.

    The three people followed the police into the police car, but by coincidence, the location was right at the gate of the school, and it was school time in the morning. There were many people coming and going. When they saw their school beauty leaving with the police, many inexplicable guesses came out.

    "What do you think happened to the three of them? How come even the police were dispatched?"

    "I don't know. I heard that the school beauty is a daughter of a rich family. Is there something in the family?"

    "Yeah, right? How can you not have anything happen if you have so much money?"

    Sometimes people's hearts are as vicious as their mouths. It's obviously just a normal thing, but for some reason it starts to get more and more outrageous when it comes to the mouths of some idiots.

    However, although these discussions were not heard by Chen Mu and the others, they happened to be heard by Wang Yi who was passing by. "What did you say? Who allowed you to talk nonsense? Do you deserve a beating?" It was true that Wang Yi wanted to teach Chen Mu a lesson, but he had no intention of involving Su Linyi, so naturally he couldn't bear it when he heard someone say bad things about Su Linyi.

    Shinobu, who was still chewing his tongue just now, was frightened by Wang Yi's sudden words. They all panicked and did not dare to say anything bad about Su Linyi. However, Wang Yi felt that his effect had been achieved, so he went to class arrogantly.

    He knew that what happened last night had nothing to do with Su Linyi, and that nothing would happen to Su Linyi even if he went to the police station. But when he thought that the people he photographed yesterday were all beaten up by Chen Mu and hospitalized, and Chen Mu was very angry and asked people to tell him those words, he became even more angry.

    "Chen Mu, I will definitely make you pay the price. So what if you beat one of my men? There are so many killer organizations that I don't believe you will survive." Wang Yi said fiercely in his heart. Before, he just wanted to teach Chen Mu a lesson, but now he was thinking about how to kill Chen Mu.

    Wang Yi is now very twisted in his heart, but it cannot be seen on the surface. He still goes to class in normal clothes, and the rumors about Su Linyi have slowly subsided. After all, no one wants to offend a powerful second generation ancestor, right?

    Chen Mu felt that he had been speechless since he traveled through time. He had a lot of troubles that he didn't talk about. Now he had to answer some boring questions with the deputy director named Yang Huanjia. He found that he was now increasingly unable to understand the thinking of people on this planet.

    "Name."

    "Chen Mu."

    "Gender."
